verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements SaaS that holds customer and usage data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers check/track, billing, the CLI, MCP and webhooks, but nothing on retention policies, customer or data deletion endpoints, or purge controls. The open-source repo can be run locally, but the pack never connects that to retention or deletion control, so it doesn't count here.
